facts.fact: The ILO diagnostic of November 2021 states that e-RCEV, the modernised civil registration and vital statistics system, has automatically assigned the unique citizen number (NUIC) to newborns since 2017, does not yet digitise records from before 2017, and that the government is in the early stages of deploying it; for deaths it states only that the hospital module MGDH shares death records with e-RCEV.
The ILO diagnostic of November 2021 names the National Directorate of Registries and Notaries as the institution holding e-RCEV and as the entity responsible for the NUIC.
